capabilities: Move the cursor right and left briefly on startup
Trigger DataView expressions in the first opened note
disambiguation: Not a cursor or editing tool; the cursor movement is only a trick to trigger DataView rendering at startup.
extras: The README's problem and solution examples are images (removed in this text); contribution guidance points to the Obsidian docs.
intentEvidence: Obsidian plugin to move the cursor to the right and back to the left when starting up.
problem: DataView expressions embedded in the first note opened (such as a Home file) do not run until the user interacts, leaving them blank on startup.

relations.evidence: To keep DataView expressions from not running on the first load of, say, your Home file.

summary: Startup utility that nudges the cursor right then left in the first opened note so DataView expressions render without user interaction.
